items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Although it was the same management, it was the same Frank Sebastian. But we went in there, we played there...

ctx.x: I don't care who came in there, they had to take Lionel. So I couldn't use my drummer. I just paid him and he could do whatever he wanted to, but we paid him and Lionel was getting his own pay from Frank Sebastian as a specialty artist.
Would he go into a big drum solo?
